book.name: MATAIYO
book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Mataiyo wana Leleli

content: Bahi Nuku Teteli Heyagimiu
Inoke Yeisu i baek boda elal ge wana tohago elal i ba,
“Logugui ana topankite ge Palisi heliya Mosese wana Logugui ana toatena ge ana totalisi.
Inoke analiya nuku hago ge wali baaba gegewena nuku toulil, yaa bahi nuku giginol ni oola hauna hi giginol, kaiwena toto hi papaatena-an, nige hi giginol i oola.
Wali logugui i gewi inoke ami kalikalivai pupulowanina hi pewa, yaa heliya nige bugul etega hi giginol tage pulowan etega nihi kalivai.

Bugul gegewena bolo hi ginol, he hi ginolil kaiwena nuwaliya gamagalau nihi kitel ge nihi atena tage heliya towaisi. Nabwa bolo Buki Bwabwalena puna ona hi lokeya ge hi am hikan lamwaliyaa, nabwa bolo ya hi ginol pwabwaya. I ola al, kula toto ali kaliko buhuna ana kula hi payapu.
Hagali elana nuwaliya nihi misiyowa yau toto gamagalau bwabwatal wali yau elana, ge limi tapwalolo elana nuwaliya nihi misiyo houwa gamagalau maniniliyaa.
Ebo gamagalau nihi pwawal abamaket elana, nuwaliya te gamagalau ginebi ge wali awatauwan nihi pata ateu owa eliyalil ge nihi awa babala-agil.
Bahi alomiyau nihi aawa babala-agimiu, kaiwena wami Babala maisena ya ge gegewemiu ku awa talitalin ya.
Bahi panayawi gamagalina etega nuku aawa tamani, kaiwena Tamamiu maisena ya, iya iyoho labulabumwa.
Bahi gamagalau nihi aawa tohouwa-agimiu, kaiwena wami tohouwa maisena, iya Mesaiya.
Henala ebo alana i bwata gamwamiwa, iya ni tabwa wami totuwalali.
Henala ebo totona ni teli heyan, Yehoba ni teli lowan, ge henala totona ni teli lowan, Yehoba ni teli heyan.
Palisi wali Kakawi kaiwena Lahi Nihi Pwawa

Eeu, Logugui ana topankite ge Palisi geb! Tokakakawi komiu, bwaliga nuku nak! Yehoba wana abalogugui ana nog ku kausa gamagalau maniniliyaa. He komiu nige ku uulutuk, ge bolo nuwaliya nihi ulutuk wali kamwasa ku kaus.

Eeu, Logugui ana topankite ge Palisi geb! Tokakakawi komiu, bwaliga nuku nak! Abuabulau wali limi ge wali gogomwau ku aahe ku lologugui-an bwabwage, ge i ola al wami awanun ku papayapu-an gamagalau tanaliyaa tage nihi hagomiu. Wami pagan o kaiwena, inoke nasi ami lahi ni bwata hot.

Eeu, Logugui ana topankite ge Palisi geb! Tokakakawi komiu, bwaliga nuku nak! Kamwasa gegewena ku labose haba inoke gamagal etega nuwana nuku gove, nuku ahe ge ni toulilimiu. Komiu Gehena ana gamagalau, yaa sauga gamagal ya ku ahe, ku paatena inoke i tabwa Gehena ana gamagal hot.

Eeu geb! Komiu tonul nanakil matamiu i kai, bwaliga nuku nak! Komiu ku ba, ‘Ebo gamagal etega ni papasila Limi Bwabwalena elana, i bosowaina ya wana bateli ni leke yoho; yaa ebo gamagal etega ni papasila Limi Bwabwalena ana gold elana, he nige bosowaina wana bateli ni leke yoho.’
Komiu tosigasiga matamiu i kai. Hauna toto i bwata, gold i bwata o ebo Limi Bwabwalena i bwata? He Limi Bwabwalena ana bwabwalena kaiwena inoke gold i bwabwalena.

Komiu ku ba al, ‘Ebo gamagal etega ni papasila pat elal bolo hi vatal abapowon, i bosowaina ya wana bateli ni leke yoho; yaa ebo gamagal etega ni papasila bwasumu toto hi popowonan elana, he nige bosowaina wana bateli ni leke yoho.’
Tomatakai komiu! Hauna toto i bwata, bwasumu i bwata o ebo abapowon i bwata? He abapowon ana bwabwalena kaiwena inoke bwasumu i bwabwalena.
Inoke sauga ebo gamagal etega ni papasila abapowon elana, i papasila abapowon elana ginebi ge bwasumu toto hi popowonan.
I ola al, sauga ebo gamagal etega ni papasila Limi Bwabwalena elana, i papasila Limi Bwabwalena elana ge Yehoba toto i miminaa o elana.
Ge sauga ebo gamagal etega ni papasila labulabum elana, i papasila Yehoba wana abamisiyo wawasana elana ge iya elana.

Eeu, Logugui ana topankite ge Palisi geb! Tokakakawi komiu, bwaliga nuku nak. Awenuwa ololana kusai, boboyuwa ge kemanana ku wali paelulutega ge wali maisena ku pek Yehoba elana wami mulolu, i ola ana logugui. Logugui o ku toulil nabiyan, yaa Yehoba wana logugui ana nuwatu bwabwatal ku nuluwagil nige ku giginol, logugui ololal wala ginol ni sapu, avalau ta atilomwan-agil ge ta baaba tunahot. Binimala logugui bolo ya nuku henapuan ge awenuwa ali logugui nuku henapuan al.

Komiu tonul nanakil matamiu i kai! Logugui bolo ali nuwatu nige i bwabwata ku toulil bubun, yaa logugui bwabwatal ku nuluwagil. Komiu uluulu ku ahek yoho ami wewel elana, yaa kamel bwabwaligena nige ku kikite inoke ku tinon alona wewel.

Eeu, Logugui ana topankite ge Palisi geb! Tokakakawi komiu, bwaliga nuku nak! Komiu ku ola gamagalau kom ge mwaha eputeteliya hi ul, yaa gamwaliya nige hi uul. Tola ku abubun, yaa kaoma ge naknak paganina i kalaopop atemiwa.
Komiu Palisi matamiu i kai! Houwan kom ge mwaha gamwaliya nuku ul bubun inoke noleleya abwe ni yanayana.

Eeu, Logugui ana topankite ge Palisi geb! Tokakakawi komiu, bwaliga nuku nak! Komiu ku ola salai toto hi abubun ge hi paisela. Noleleya ana awa i waisi, yaa gamwanaa tomati tutuwana ge bweyanina i kalaopop.
He i ola al, noleleya gamagalau hi kitemiu tage komiu ku waisi, yaa lokalokakawi ge nak paganina i kalaopop atemiwa.
Eeu, Logugui ana topankite ge Palisi geb! Tokakakawi komiu, bwaliga nuku nak! Palopitau ali salai ku ginol ge tonowakau houhouwel bolo wali pagan i sapu salailiya ku paisela.
Yaka ku ba tage binimala komiu iyoho tubumiyau houhouwel wali sauga elana, nige nuku giginol ni ola heliya hi ginol, palopitau nige nuku lolopaaligal.
Ku ba ola o, he iyaka ku pamasalimiu age komiu totaulol tubuliyau, bolo palopitau hi lolopaaligal.
He ku ginol pwataniwa ya! Inoke pagan toto tubumiyau hi telipuna-an nuku pwamowasi!
Komiu ku ola mwata! Mwata natunau komiu! Nige bosowaina nuku mwal, he komiu iyaka Gehena.

Inoke na baewa eliyamiu, palopitau ge tosiba bwabwatal ge topankite ya papatunal eliyamiu. Enuna nuku lolil, enuna nuku lokolosil, enuna nuku nibinibihagil wami limi tapwalolo gamwanaa, ge enuna nuku takel pwatapwatagil nihi nok panuwa tomaha ge tomaha elal.

Inoke taulol gegewena ana lahi komiu nuku pwawa, taulol toto gamagalau wali pagan sasapona hi lolil, i telipunaa Eibol hi lol ana siga Sakalaiya, Balakaiya natuna, komiu Yudiya ku lol Limi Bwabwalena ge abapowon ali hawawala.
Ya ba tunahot eliyamiu, taulol bolo gegewena o lahena nihi paheya komiu heyan ya eliyamiu.
Yeisu Nuwana I Nak Yelusalema ana Tomina kaiweliya

Eeu geb Yelusalema ana tomina! Komiu palopitau ku lolil ge bolo Yehoba i patunal eliyamiu ku loipatagil. Sauga i gewi nuwau wami gamagalau na bugul papahel, ni ola kamkam meluyovana natunau i bugul papahel opena gabulanaa, yaa nige nuwamiu i oola.
He inoke wami Limi Bwabwalena Yehoba ni galaluwai ge ni enonovan.
Na baewa eliyamiu, nige al nuku kikiteyau ana siga na sikalim al, inoke sauga o nuku tobalagau nuku ba, ‘Yehoba ni ba muloluan, iya i nem Babala alana elana!’”

footnotes.text: Buki ana toleli papanet bolo houhouwel, enuna puna 14 ana baaba hi leli, enuna nige hi leleli.
